ph-scale.alt: The pH scale from 0 to 14 at 25 °C. Hydronium concentration falls from 1 M at pH 0 to 10 to the minus 14 M at pH 14, while hydroxide concentration rises the other way. Below pH 7 is acidic, pH 7 is neutral, above 7 is basic. One pH unit is a factor of ten in hydronium concentration; pH plus pOH is 14.00 at 25 °C.
